Name: Better Dying Grandpa
Author: MattytheMouse
Description:
Better Dying Grandpa...

Yeah, that's the title I'm going with.

Better Dying Grandpa replaces the art at the very beginning of the game with something[i] slightly[/i] more well drawn. Unfortunately, Grandpa's fire will no longer have four frames of animation which some may consider a game breaker, but on the plus side Grandpa's deathbed is no longer a cot with mismatched legs.

Don't start a new save game without this one folks. Install Better Dying Grandpa today! [s]Nude version is on its way.[/s]

Downloads.Description: Simply place in your Stardew Valley folder, extract, and replace files.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
